QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Teacher
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012111##k is looking for you again. What could he want this time?
QuestInfo.1: #p1012111# says his old teacher, #b#p1022006##k, is looking for help. But you've never heard of #b#m102020400##k, and have no clue where #b#m102000000##k is.

0.0: Mercedes, thank you for your work. My research is chugging along just fine now. However, one of my colleagues is in need of your help. Are you busy?\r\n#L0##bMy help?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes! My teacher, Dr. #b#p1022006##k, asked me if I knew any good assistants. My response, of course, was 'Do I EVER!' He's studying the monsters in #m102000000#. \r\n#L0##b#m102000000#? Where's that?#l\n#k
0.2: Really? You don't know where #m102000000# is? You know, you're great at random tasks, but just terrible with directions. Anyway, #m102000000# is northeast of #m100000000##k. It's like THE place for warriors. \r\n#L0##bHm... Are you sure it's not just barren mountains out that way? Completely uninhabitable?#l\n#k
0.3: For sane people, maybe, but the warriors seem to like it! Anyway, could you meet with Dr. #p1022006#? I think he's in the #b#m102020400##k just outside of #m102000000#.\nGreat! Please meet with my teacher.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to #m102020400# automatically.)#n#k

no.0: If you don't know where #m102000000# is, just open your map.

1.0: I say, you must be Mercedes. #p1012111# has told me so much about you! You're as elegant as he said, though your ears are a tad peculiar...\r\n#L0##bI'll have you know that I have beautiful ears, by Elven standards!#l\n#k
1.1: Ah, and there's that peculiar accent he told me about!

yes.0: Well, that's fine by me! If you're as helpful as Betty says, you can be as eccentric as you want.

npc.0: Dr. #b#p1022006##k is waiting you in the #b#m102020400##k near #m102000000#. You didn't get lost, did you?
